hit_points.formula_note: At Acolyte levels, gain 6 HP + Constitution modifier per level.

design_identity.combat_style: Bless allies, punish the profane, create safe zones, and manage sacred charges through consecration
weaknesses: Weaker when forced into pure damage races

sacred_doctrine.description: The Acolyte chooses a guiding doctrine that changes the emphasis of their holy arts.

consecration.description: Through Aqua Benedicta, the Acolyte creates Holy Water Charges that can empower restoration, judgement, blessing, or sanctuary effects.

overchannel_rules.description: Intensified effects include the base effect. Overload effects include base and intensified effects unless explicitly stated otherwise.
overchannel_rules.baseline_scaling_rule: All modular Acolyte skills gain milestone scaling automatically with character level. Overchannel only amplifies the current cast.

level_6.transition_note: Nivel ideal para comenzar la especialización hacia el Second Job.

skills.name: Sacred Doctrine
skills.duration: Until switched off, replaced by another doctrine, or combat ends
skills.description: El Acolyte adopta una doctrina sagrada que define si sus artes priorizan protección divina o castigo contra lo impuro.

base_effects.healing_done_bonus: Add your wisdom modifier to any healing you do

effects.healing_done_bonus: Add your wisdom modifier to any healing you do

Demon Bane.identity: Exorcism, radiant punishment and anti-profane pressure

base_effects.radiant_damage_bonus: Add your wisdom modifier to any radiant damage you deal

effects.radiant_damage_bonus: Add your wisdom modifier to any radiant damage you deal

synergies: Defines whether the Acolyte leans toward support or sacred offense
Interacts strongly with Restoration and Judgement
design_notes: This replaces Divine Protection and Demon Bane as passive skills.
Should feel like a meaningful combat stance choice.

skills.name: Restoration
skills.description: El Acolyte canaliza gracia restauradora para sanar o purificar, adaptando el milagro según la necesidad del momento.

intensified_effect.effect: Target also gains 1d4 temporary hit points until the start of your next turn.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Holy Water Charge. Target also removes one removable negative condition and temporary hit points become 1d6.

intensified_effect.effect: Target also gains advantage on its next saving throw before the end of its next turn.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Holy Water Charge. If the target had no removable condition, it instead gains 1d6 temporary hit points.

base.effect: Use the current milestone-scaled base form of the chosen Restoration mode.

intensified.effect: Use the base form and add the intensified effect.

overload.effect: Use the base form, add the intensified effect, and add the overload effect.

skills.name: Sanctuary Rite
skills.description: El Acolyte consagra el espacio cercano para revelar amenazas ocultas o crear un refugio momentáneo contra el castigo a distancia.

intensified_effect.effect: Revealed enemies take -1 to saving throws against holy effects until the start of your next turn.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Holy Water Charge. Revealed enemies take 1d4 radiant damage and cannot take reactions until the start of their next turn.

Pneuma.identity: Protective sacred zone against ranged pressure and hostile magic

base_effect.effect: Allies inside the zone gain bonus AC against ranged attacks and spell attack rolls originating from outside the zone.

intensified_effect.effect: Enemies attacking targets inside the zone with ranged attacks or spell attack rolls do so with Disadvantage.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Holy Water Charge. Allies inside the zone gain Resistance to all non-melee damage originating from outside the zone.

base.effect: Use the current milestone-scaled base form of Ruwach or Pneuma.

intensified.effect: Use the base form and add the intensified effect.

overload.effect: Use the base form, add the intensified effect, and add the overload effect.

skills.name: Benediction
requires: Ally or enemy within 9m depending on chosen blessing
skills.description: El Acolyte pronuncia una bendición o una negación sagrada que acelera, fortalece o debilita el flujo del combate.

intensified_effect.effect: The target also gains +1 spell attack rolls and +1 healing received.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Holy Water Charge. The target also deals +1d4 radiant damage on its first successful hit each turn.

intensified_effect.Decrease Agility: Target also cannot take reactions until the end of its next turn.

overload_effect.Increase Agility: Consumes 1 Holy Water Charge. Target ignores difficult terrain and cannot be slowed for 1 turn.
overload_effect.Decrease Agility: Consumes 1 Holy Water Charge. Target also suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws for 1 turn.

intensified_effect.effect: Target also gains 1d4 temporary hit points.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Holy Water Charge. Target also gains advantage on saving throws against forced movement and Prone.

base.effect: Use the current milestone-scaled base version of the chosen blessing.

intensified.effect: Use the base version and add the intensified effect.

overload.effect: Use the base version, add the intensified effect, and add the overload effect.

skills.name: Judgement
skills.description: El Acolyte invoca juicio santo para castigar a un enemigo con luz divina o para marcar a una presencia impura con condena sagrada.

intensified_effect.effect: The target cannot benefit from invisibility or stealth until the end of its next turn.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Holy Water Charge. On failed Constitution save, the target is Blinded for 1 turn.

base_effect.on_failed_save: Target suffers -1 attack rolls and -1 saving throws for 2 turns

effects.on_failed_save: -1 attack rolls, -1 saving throws for 2 turns
-2 attack rolls, -1 saving throws for 2 turns
-2 attack rolls, -2 saving throws for 2 turns

intensified_effect.effect: Against undead or demons, Signum Crucis also applies -1 AC.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Holy Water Charge. Target also takes +1d4 radiant damage from holy sources for 2 turns.

base.effect: Use the current milestone-scaled base version of the chosen judgement.

intensified.effect: Use the base version and add the intensified effect.

overload.effect: Use the base version, add the intensified effect, and add the overload effect.

skills.name: Aqua Benedicta
skills.description: El Acolyte consagra agua ordinaria y la transforma en una reserva de poder litúrgico que alimenta milagros más intensos.
synergies: Empowers Restoration, Benediction, Judgement and Sanctuary Rite overload states
Gives the Acolyte a distinct technical layer separate from raw MP
design_notes: This is the defining internal resource tool of the Acolyte.

skills.name: Pilgrim's Passage
requires: Self, ally, or valid destination depending on chosen mode
skills.description: El Acolyte invoca un tránsito sagrado: un paso breve para reposicionarse o una apertura litúrgica para guiar el viaje.

base_effect.effect: Teleport target up to 6m to a visible point

intensified_effect.effect: The teleported target ignores opportunity attacks until the end of the turn.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Holy Water Charge. Teleport self and one adjacent ally, and both arrive cleansed of Slow or similar movement debuffs.

base_effect.effect: Create an out-of-combat portal or travel anchor as allowed by campaign rules

intensified_effect.effect: Extend portal duration or expand party utility

overload_effect.effect: Enable stronger ritual travel effect at GM/system discretion

base.effect: Use the current base version of the chosen passage.

intensified.effect: Use the base version and add the intensified effect.

overload.effect: Use the base version, add the intensified effect, and add the overload effect.

design_notes: Warp Portal can remain mostly ritual/out-of-combat until later testing.

core_design_rules: El Acolyte es un support táctico, protector y exorcista, no solo un sanador.
Sacred Doctrine reemplaza Divine Protection y Demon Bane como elección activa de identidad.
Restoration reemplaza Heal y Cure como skill modular de restauración y purificación.
Benediction reemplaza Blessing, Increase Agility, Decrease Agility y Angelus como familia de bendiciones.
Sanctuary Rite reemplaza Ruwach y Pneuma como sistema de santuario y revelación.
Judgement reemplaza Holy Light y Signum Crucis como skill ofensiva sagrada modular.
Aqua Benedicta es el sistema técnico diferencial del Acolyte y genera Holy Water Charges.
Pilgrim's Passage reemplaza Teleportation y Warp Portal como movilidad táctica y utilidad ritual.
El Second Job no debería reemplazar este kit, sino profundizar sus doctrinas, bendiciones y exorcismos.
